tool.name: Microsoft Agent 365
tool.description: Control plane to observe, govern and secure an organization's AI agents via a central registry, Entra, Purview and Defender.
strengths: Central agent registry and agent map
Entra, Purview and Defender coverage for agents
Agent activity in Purview unified audit log
tool.pricing: $15.00 user/month paid yearly (standalone); included in Microsoft 365 E7 ($99.00 user/month paid yearly).
tool.statusNote: Generally available for the Commercial segment since 2026-05-01; registry sync with AWS Bedrock and Google Cloud was announced as public preview at GA.
tool.practitionerNote: Strongest fit for Microsoft 365 / E5 tenants that want agent inventory and policy in the same Entra, Purview and Defender stack as users; licensing is per user, so model cost against everyone who owns or uses managed agents.
tool.logoNotes: Fallback: no reviewed logo asset sourced yet.

dataResidency.detail: Agent 365 overview and GA post do not state data-residency commitments specific to Agent 365.

deployment.detail: Microsoft-hosted cloud service managed from the Microsoft 365 admin center; no self-hosted option.

auditLogging.detail: Agent invocations, tool calls, inference calls and guardrail events are recorded in the Microsoft 365 (Purview) audit log.

soc2.detail: No Agent 365-specific SOC 2 scope statement found in the reviewed sources.

iso27001.detail: No Agent 365-specific ISO 27001 scope statement found in the reviewed sources.

iso42001.detail: Agent 365 is not in Microsoft's published list of AI services in scope for ISO 42001 (as of review).

euAiAct.detail: Governance and security tooling for agents, not itself an AI system placed on the market; obligations rest with agent providers and deployers.

licenseRisk.detail: Proprietary Microsoft SaaS licensed per user; ties agent governance to the Microsoft 365 security stack.
